verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for a compliance SaaS like ComplyAdvantage Mesh, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The cited material covers screening, risk scoring, case management, webhooks and APIs. An llms.txt file only makes the docs readable to external LLMs and is not a built-in assistant.
